name: Daily German construction tenders with GAEB positions (Apify)

parameters.content:
## Daily German construction tenders with GAEB positions (Apify)

### How it works

This workflow runs automatically on weekdays at 07:00 to retrieve German public construction tenders (CPV 45) using the [German Construction Tenders + GAEB Extractor](https://apify.com/brsksr/german-construction-tenders-gaeb). It calls the Apify actor synchronously via HTTP to search directly inside GAEB Bills of Quantities (`.x83`, `.d83`, `.p83`), then formats the returned results into one item per tender with buyer, deadline, place of performance, GAEB position counts, and matching line-item excerpts.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger with your desired weekday run time.
- Get your Apify API token from [Apify Console -> Settings -> Integrations](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations) and replace `YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` in the **Post to Apify API** node URL.
- Adjust `keywords` (e.g., `Wärmepumpe`, `Photovoltaik`, `Beton`) and optional `postalCodePrefixes` in the JSON body.
- Connect your preferred output node (Slack, Teams, Email, or Google Sheets) after **Format Tender Details** and map `{{$json.message}}`.

### Customization

Adjust the schedule, Apify actor input parameters (`pubDaysBack`, `keywords`, `postalCodePrefixes`, `nutsPrefixes`, `maxTenders`), or formatting code to match your trade and region.

## Fetch and format tenders

A compact left-to-right workflow cluster that triggers on weekday mornings, runs the Apify actor to collect German construction tenders, and formats the returned tender data for downstream use.
